name: Lamprey
appearance: An elongated jawless fish with a circular suction mouth that fastens onto prey. The print gives no color or body length.

habitats: Fresh water and salt water (common lamprey listed in both summoning tables)

Combat.name: Bite and attachment
Combat.effectNote: A bite deals 1–2 damage. The lamprey fastens on with its round mouth and starts draining on the next round. The shared aquatic text gives 2 HP per Hit Die each round thereafter.

Combat.name: Drain at the table
Combat.effectNote: The 1994 paragraph leaves whose Hit Dice unstated. The original Monster Manual uses the lamprey’s Hit Dice, which gives this 1+2 HD form 2 HP per round.

Combat.name: Sea lamprey saving throws
Combat.effectNote: The −2 penalty to saving throws against fire-based attacks applies to sea lampreys in the prose.

notes: Common Lamprey appears in both aquatic summoning tables on p. 378. Salt Water V also lists a Sea Lamprey.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, Fish pp. 117–118 and summoning pp. 377–378.

name: Giant Lamprey
appearance: A large lamprey with a long, thick body and circular attaching mouth. The proportions are an illustration choice. The print gives no size category or palette.

Combat.name: Bite and attachment
Combat.effectNote: A bite deals 1–6 damage. The shared aquatic Lamprey text starts the drain on the next round after attachment and gives a rate of 2 HP per Hit Die each round.

Combat.name: Drain at the table
Combat.effectNote: The original Monster Manual explicitly gives the Giant Lamprey 10 HP of drain damage per round for its own 5 Hit Dice. This follows the shared 1994 rate, which does not spell out whose HD are used.

notes: The 1994 Fish entry gives Giant Lamprey its own table row and shared aquatic Lamprey prose. The summoning table names Sea Lamprey separately.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, Fish pp. 117–118 and summoning pp. 377–378.

name: Land Lamprey
appearance: A slender terrestrial lamprey with a circular attaching mouth. The portrait shows it with a long flexible body and reduced-looking fins. The text gives no color.

Combat.name: Initial attachment
Combat.effectNote: A hit for 1 point of damage attaches the lamprey.

Combat.name: Drain
Combat.effectNote: An attached lamprey drains 1 HP per round for three rounds unless killed or removed. Each attached lamprey imposes the equivalent of a −1 Dexterity penalty.

notes: The table lists two attacks and 1 HP/round. The description gives the attachment hit and ongoing drain without explaining the second attack or a removal check.
The Land Lamprey appears under general Monster Summoning II on p. 377.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, Fish pp. 117–118 and summoning pp. 377–378.
